en: Dependent on a wholesome state that is not acquired by clinging but is subject to clinging, a state that is neither acquired by clinging nor subject to clinging and is unwholesome arises by way of root condition … three.

Dependent on a wholesome state that is neither acquired by clinging nor subject to clinging, a state that is neither acquired by clinging nor subject to clinging and is unwholesome arises by way of root condition … three. (Abbreviated. In the case of root [condition], there are six; in the case of predominance, there are six … pe … in the case of non-disappearance, there are six.

Dependent on an unclung-to, subject-to-clinging, unwholesome state, there arises a state that is neither clung-to nor subject-to-clinging and is not unwholesome, by way of root condition. (Abbreviated. Under root condition there are three; under predominance condition there are three ... pe ... under non-disappearance condition there are three.

Dependent on a clung-to, subject-to-clinging, indeterminate state, there arises a state that is neither clung-to nor subject-to-clinging and is not indeterminate, by way of root condition. (Abbreviated. Under root condition there are five ... pe ... under non-disappearance condition there are five.
